policy: Measure 12 balanced triples per edit on one CPU set after an excluded warmup for every arm. Report paired medians, 96.14% distribution-free median intervals and both six-triple medians. Favor an individual change with >2% lower first-edit wall time and an interval excluding zero on at least one edit, corroboration on the other, and no repeatable material regression. Examine any cold slowdown above 2%. Require fresh and cached behavioral agreement, matching rebuild rosters across the arms and zero recompiles on settled checks. Keep every rejection.
